messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate on /v1/embeddings/batch - paging errors detected (slo: 99.9%). Investigating. Pager: @sana :rotating_light:

Sana: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs from reranker batch pool now.

Jon: seeing 502s from rerank-service in the logs, looks tied to downstream matcher returning empty vectors.

Alyssa: confirming customer reports: some search queries return no results, other queries slow. Hits started ~ 02:13 UTC.

Sana: timeline so far: 02:11 deploy of embedder-v2.3 to batch nodes (canary), 02:13 error spike. Rolling back canary now.

Lee: rollback in progress on canary nodes. Patching traffic to fallback model (embedder-v2.2) for all batch endpoints to stop error cascade.

Jon: extracting stack from reranker, pushing gist: https://internal.gist/abc123 (logs obfuscated). key error excerpt: 
```
ERROR reranker.service RequestHandler - downstream_matcher returned vectors length=0 expected=768
Trace: ValueError: vector length mismatch
 at match_pipeline.py:142
```

Maria: copying raw request payload for failed batch: `{"ids": [..], "vectors": [[0.12, 0.34, ...]]}` one sample shows vector length 0 for item 3.

Sana: hypothesis 1: embedder canary produced an empty vector for some items (serialization bug). Hypothesis 2: batch reshaping on batch endpoint caused vector slicing to zero-length when padding/truncation boundary hit.

Alyssa: customer impact: ~3% of requests received empty results; some saw 500/502. We should flag affected customers and create incident page.

Sana: mitigation actions so far:
- rolled back embedder canary to v2.2
- routed all new batch requests to v2.2 fallback
- increased retry window on reranker to tolerate transient empties

Lee: live mitigation note: temporarily disabled continuous batching for the batch endpoint to avoid boundary chopping while we debug. Performance will degrade ~10-15% but stops incorrect vector shapes.

Jon: pulled segmentation logs from batch node 17: shows batch assembly logic hitting an off-by-one during multiplexed requests. Log snippet:
```
INFO batch.assembler assembling payload size=4096 items=32 expected_len=24576
WARN batch.assembler truncating vector idx=21 computed_len=0
```

Maria: attached a few full request/response pairs to the thread (redacted). Also adding a hash of payloads: sha256: f7e3...

Alyssa: ops-bot: please notify PS for customers with >50 rps and open a severity-2 advisory stating degraded embeddings for specific endpoints.

ops-bot: PS notified, severity set to S2, incident channel created: #incident-rerank-paging-1832109876.

Sana: I'm going to instrument extra checks in the embedder client and batch assembler to assert vector lengths before send. Will push a hotfix branch and coordinate deploy. ETA ~ 25m.

Jon: temporary safety check applied on reranker: if vector length==0 drop item and return partial results instead of 502. Patch ID: patch/1832-safe-drop.

Lee: rolling patch to disable multiplexing on nodes 15-20 to isolate.

Sana: reproduce steps I used locally: run embedder with test payload of mixed doc lengths, then emulate batching with multiplex factor 4. Script: 
```
python tools/repro_batch_bug.py --model v2.3 --multiplex 4 --samples 1000
```
Observed 0-length vector at index 21 consistently.

Jon: long-term fix candidates: fix serialization in v2.3 embedder OR add defensive reshaping in batch assembler. Prefer to patch assembler first (faster).

Maria: collecting customer logs for postmortem. Please add affected request IDs to the incident doc. I'll own the customer impact section.

Sana: hotfix branch pushed: `hotfix/assembler-length-guard`. Running smoke tests now.

Alyssa: reminder: keep all conversation in this thread for RCA tracking. We'll convert to a formal postmortem once incident is resolved.

Sana: smoke looks good on staging. Requesting canary deploy of hotfix to one batch node.

Lee: canary hotfix deployed to node 18. Monitoring.

Jon: node 18 shows no truncation logs; other patched nodes still showing earlier pattern.

Sana: promoting hotfix to remaining nodes. Rolling through now.

ops-bot: automated check: error-rate on /v1/embeddings/batch decreased from 6.2% -> 0.8% after hotfix promotion (5m window).

Alyssa: customer update drafted and sent to impacted tenants.

Maria: collecting evidence for RCA: logs, timelines, code diffs, and test repro. I'll collate into doc: https://internal.docs/reranker-rca/1832109876 (placeholder).

Sana: final hypothesis for RCA: a change in v2.3 embedder serialized an empty vector for certain edge tokenization cases; combined with multiplex/batch assembler off-by-one it produced zero-length vectors reaching reranker, causing downstream 502s. Root cause spans embedder change + assembler boundary bug.

Jon: post-incident action items (owners):
- add vector-length assertions in batch assembler (sana)
- rollback/remove risky serialization code in embedder (team: ml-embedder)
- add e2e test with multiplex reproduction (jon)
- update monitoring/alerting to detect vector len==0 (lee)

Alyssa: oncall handoff: @sana will cover next hour then handoff to @lee at 04:30 UTC.

Sana: handing off to @lee at 04:30 UTC. I'll remain available for questions.

Lee: taking over. Will schedule follow-up postmortem meeting and link notes.

Alyssa: closing incident thread for now. Please add any missing logs or notes. We'll publish RCA draft in 24h. :white_check_mark:
